independent_counterexample.recurrence: Rows1,2 give U11=U12=U22=1. Row3 has only lower slot(3,1), multiplier1. Its remaining row positions {3} do not intersect pivot row1 upper positions {2}, so no update occurs and U33=1.
independent_counterexample.conclusion: All pivots1; L=I+E31,U=I+E12, LU=A+E32, so (LU)32=1 outside P and A-LU=-E32.
independent_counterexample.count_sanity_by_direct_algebra: ell=1,q=4,s=5,u=1,I=0,J=2. Setup uses1 division, no multiply/subtract updates; sparse application uses2 multiplications,2 subtractions,3 divisions. This is mathematical inspection, not a test run.

rich_sound_contract.factor_slots: For canonical sorted no-duplicate/no-input-zero CSR and successful setup, L strict-lower stored slots exactly P_L={(i,k) in P:i>k}; U stored slots exactly P_U={(k,j) in P:k<=j}; L unit diagonal implicit. Updated zero values retain structural slots.
rich_sound_contract.storage: ell=|P_L|,q=|P_U|,s=nnz(A); ell+q=s numeric slots. Does not assert nnz of product or all factor values remain nonzero.
rich_sound_contract.setup: R_ik={j>k:(i,j) in P},C_k={j>k:(k,j) in P}; I=sum|R_ik intersect C_k| and J=sum(|R_ik|+|C_k|) over P_L. Exactly ell divisions,I multiplications,I subtractions; at most J merge comparisons besides n row/s entry validation visits.
rich_sound_contract.application: Using stored strict-lower/strict-upper slots in two triangular solves: exactly s-n multiplications,s-n subtractions,n divisions. Successful nonzero pivots give well-defined invertible triangular factors.
rich_sound_contract.failure_and_limits: Preserve invalid-pattern/missing-diagonal/zero-pivot branches, and nonfinite failure for any rounded extension. No A=LU, no support(LU) subset P, no convergence/conditioning/accuracy guarantee and no universal O(nnz) setup bound.
rich_sound_contract.smallest_missing_prerequisite: No new item/page/pair. Correct the controlling premise to distinguish factor slots from matrix-product support; retain actual author count theorem and counterexample.
